breakdown.description: Both RAS and LES models are defined in `turbulenceProperties`. An OpenFOAM simulation cannot be both RAS and LES simultaneously; one must be chosen.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly resolved the conflict of having both RAS and LES models defined. It specified a hybrid RANS-LES simulation using the kEpsilonDES model. In this specific context (a hybrid/DES model), it is correct to define both RAS and LES sub-dictionaries within the `turbulenceProperties` file, as the solver uses them for different regions of the flow. The agent correctly identified this valid configuration, thus fixing the initial inconsistency.
